HER NATURAL SPUNK

BIGGEST INSECURITY?

DERMATOLOGISTS IN NEW YORK CITY.

RELATABLE AND REGAL

TONIGHT, THE SEASON FINALE.

WHO WILL BE
AMERICA'S NEXT TOP MODEL?

IT COULD BE AMANDA.
IT COULD BE YAYA.

ME, ME, ME, ME, ME,
ME, ME, ME, ME, ME, ME.

WHAT I SEE NOW.

WENT DOWN WITH ANN,

THE PART THAT I PLAYED.

LIFE-LEARNING EXPERIENCE.

BEING OFFENSIVE

TO BE THIS BETTER PERSON,

ON SOMEBODY AND SHE'S THAT.
